```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
```

## Load packages

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(janitor)
library(countrycode)
```

## Read data

```{r}
HDI <- read_csv("data/HDR25_Composite_indices_complete_time_series.csv")

World <- st_read("data/World_Countries_(Generalized)_2173680399808997149.geojson")
```

## GII change

Calculate the change in GII between 2010 and 2019.

```{r}
HDI_selected <- HDI %>%
  select(iso3, country, gii_2010, gii_2019) %>%
  mutate(gii_change = gii_2019 - gii_2010,
         iso2 = countrycode(iso3, "iso3c", "iso2c")) %>%
  filter(!is.na(iso2))

head(HDI_selected)
```

## Join data

Join the GII data to world boundaries using ISO codes.

```{r}
World_GII <- World %>%
  left_join(HDI_selected, by = c("ISO" = "iso2"))
```

## Check results

```{r}
nrow(World_GII)
sum(!is.na(World_GII$gii_change))
```

The world boundary data has 251 records, but only 157 have valid GII changes.

Some countries and territories could not be matched, and some GII values are missing.
